name: Coding Tools MCP
description: Coding-oriented MCP tool collection that appears in the emerging DSH ecosystem: give any AI agent the ability to code.
description_zh: 面向编码的 MCP 工具集：让任何 AI Agent 获得编码能力。

name: dsh-openpencil
description: OpenPencil design preview and editing integration.
description_zh: OpenPencil 设计预览与编辑集成。

name: dsh-lark
description: Lark/Feishu IM bot channel for DeepSeek Harness | 飞书 DeepSeek Harness 插件
description_zh: Lark/Feishu IM bot channel for DeepSeek Harness | 飞书 DeepSeek Harness 插件

name: deepseek-harness-acp
description: ACP server implementation for DeepSeek Harness: exposes the full DSH agent to ACP clients while reusing credentials and sessions.
description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ACP 服务器实现：复用凭据与会话，将完整 DSH Agent 暴露给 ACP 客户端。

name: dsh-oauth-mcp-client
description: OAuth 2.1 Streamable HTTP MCP client plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description_zh: OAuth 2.1 Streamable HTTP MCP 客户端插件。

name: deepseek-harness-docker
description: Community Docker and Kubernetes packaging for @deepseek-ai/dsh with a hardened image.
description_zh: @deepseek-ai/dsh 的社区 Docker/K8s 打包，加固镜像。

name: dsh-mcp-manager
description: MCP server manager: Settings page with OAuth (PKCE + dynamic client registration) or static-token auth.
description_zh: MCP 服务器管理器：设置页 OAuth（PKCE + 动态客户端注册）或静态 Token 认证。

name: deepseek-harness-action
description: Community GitHub Action: AI code review, CI diagnosis, auto-fix and issue-to-PR implementation.
description_zh: 社区 GitHub Action：AI 代码审查、CI 诊断、自动修复、Issue 转 PR。

name: PicGo DSH Plugin
description: Official PicGo plugin: upload images/files to your image host from DSH and get public URLs.
description_zh: PicGo 官方插件：从 DSH 上传图片/文件到图床并获取公网 URL。

name: dsh-telegram-channel
description: Telegram mobile remote for live DSH Web sessions: session picker, bind/unbind, same trajectory as desktop.
description_zh: Telegram 手机远程控制 DSH 实时会话：会话选择、绑定/解绑，轨迹与桌面一致。

name: DSH Telegram Relay
description: Relay that turns Telegram into a remote conversation channel for DSH with notifications.
description_zh: 把 Telegram 变成 DSH 远程对话渠道并接收通知。

name: dsh-mcp-panel
description: Read-only runtime management panel for the official DSH MCP client: /mcp command and a Settings tab.
description_zh: 官方 DSH MCP 客户端的只读运行时管理面板：/mcp 命令 + 设置 Tab。

name: dsh-search-mcp
description: Replace DSH's built-in web search with search MCP servers (Tavily/Brave/Exa/Perplexity/DuckDuckGo).
description_zh: 用搜索 MCP 服务器（Tavily/Brave/Exa/Perplexity/DDG）替换 DSH 内置搜索。

name: dsh-browser
description: Browser capability for DeepSeek Harness: headed Edge/Playwright provider, SSRF-safe navigation, a11y-ref clicking, permission gate with auto-remember, gated evaluate
description_zh: Browser capability for DeepSeek Harness: headed Edge/Playwright provider, SSRF-safe navigation, a11y-ref clicking, permission gate with auto-remember, gated evaluate

name: dsh-harness-mcp-server
description: Expose DeepSeek Harness agent capabilities as an MCP server (brain=Hermes, arms=Harness).
description_zh: 将 DSH Agent 能力暴露为 MCP 服务器（大脑=Hermes，双手=Harness）。

name: vscode-deepseek-harness
description: Unofficial: drive your own dsh as a native VS Code chat agent.
description_zh: 非官方：把 dsh 作为 VS Code 原生聊天 Agent 使用。

name: dsh-chrome
description: Chrome profile bridge: control an existing signed-in Chrome profile through Chrome DevTools Protocol.
description_zh: Chrome 配置档桥接：通过 CDP 操控已登录的 Chrome。

name: URL Manager MCP
description: MCP companion for URL Manager: 21 tools for save/search/categorize/share with magic-link delivery.
description_zh: URL Manager 的 MCP 伴生服务器：21 个工具用于保存/搜索/分类/共享与魔法链接投递。

name: dsh4vscode
description: VS Code chat windows backed by the DSH agent: OpenCode-style independent sessions with model auto-routing.
description_zh: 由 DSH Agent 驱动的 VS Code 聊天窗口：OpenCode 风格独立会话，模型自动路由。

name: opendsh
description: Open the DeepSeek Harness Web UI inside VS Code with one-command start/stop.
description_zh: 在 VS Code 内打开 DSH Web UI，一键启停。

name: dsh-super-injector
description: Super-injector plugin (cordis) for context injection.
description_zh: 上下文注入增强插件（cordis）。

name: dsh-github-integration
description: GitHub integration plugin for DSH.
description_zh: DSH 的 GitHub 集成插件。

name: deepseek-harness-rs
description: A Rust port of DeepSeek Harness.
description_zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Rust 移植。

name: dsh-lan-access
description: LAN access for the Web GUI: 0.0.0.0 bind plus a crypto.randomUUID polyfill for non-secure contexts.
description_zh: Web GUI 局域网访问：0.0.0.0 绑定 + 非安全上下文 polyfill。

name: deepseek-harness-vsc-extension
description: DeepSeek Harness for VS Code as extension
description_zh: DeepSeek Harness for VS Code as extension
